defects.description: Two instrument defects before any certified output. (1) A control-plant arithmetic slip: the 16-set wrongness plant (15 basis + duplicate) has rank 15 as intended but the first assertion expected rank < 15; corrected to the rank-15 corank-one plant with a singular basis-column deletion (14 after deletion), i.e. a genuine (C2)(i)-style REJECT witness. (2) The n=8 all-distinct layer enumerated candidate 8-sets via combinations(product(range(8),2),8), whose generator walks C(64,8) ~ 4.43e9 tuples; the first full launch was killed by SIGXCPU at the 5400 s RLIMIT inside the GF(11) n=8 sweep with exit 152 (CPU 5400 cap; wall 6014 s of host accounting). No census data was corrupted: layers L5/L6/L7 and the L8 n=5/n=6 parts had already checkpointed correct results. Fixed by enumerating the all-distinct stratum directly as the 8! = 40320 bijections (both the sweep and the support-set comparison); the fixed sweep pilot at GF(13) returns 4 circuits = the PGL sum with the folded domain, cross-checked independently.

affected_families_rerun: complete instrument rerun from the beginning after the SIGXCPU fix
disclosure: No assertion weakened; no count repinned without recomputation; prereg unamended. The complete rerun covers L5-L8 at both primes with the fixed sweep.
